name: verdandi-render-breakdown

provenance.host_line: os=windows arch=x86_64 cpu="AMD64 Family 26 Model 36 Stepping 0, AuthenticAMD"

validity_scope.certifies: the per-phase render decomposition of the kernel on host DANIELDILLBERG for scene witness with identity tiles, 300 samples after 30 warm-ups

forbidden_interpretations: input-to-photon latency (input transport, present wait and the panel need capture hardware)
a present, a window, a compositor: none is in this number
any other host, scene, tile set or resolution; absolute us are host-specific — the permille shares are the portable quantity
a speed improvement: a breakdown is a target-finder, not an optimization; GAUNTLET-1 must prove byte-identity before any speed claim
that the witness hashes (frame_digest, pixel_sha) are interactive-render cost: they are verification-only and excluded from the render total
reading: reference render decomposed on host DANIELDILLBERG: strips 2 / frame 341 / emit 695 permille of the render p99; the largest is emit (695 permille). The 500-permille decision rule (the reader's, applied to these shares) says GAUNTLET-1 targets emit iff its share >= 500, and the incremental-floor-cast hypothesis dies unless frame >= 500. The two witness hashes are verification-only cost, excluded from the render total; the witnesses were checked before any number was taken
